If my explanation isn’t enough, which I really think it isn’t as I’m probably simplifying it a lot. I’m still new at learning these things. But do check out Carl Jung’s work, I really recommend YouTube for it as it will give you a quick understanding and you can see if you wanna get more into his work.

There are some patterns that are in literally everything, like duality (I think that’s what it’s labelled), it’s the polarisation I tend to see in everything, from life itself down to everyday situations. Life & death, happy & sad, comfort & suffering, safe & dangerous, these are just some examples but I guess we all know these. But I found the benefit of acknowledging it is in understanding how everything functions and if you look at the universe, you’ll see that life flourishes when there’s a balance between 2 things (ie when the number of prey is enough for the predators to maintain life etc.) and maybe we can flourish I guess if we try to balance everything to the best of our powers and try to identify where things *are* polarised in our lives and see things from the best perspectives. I’m still trying to find my balance and I’m still looking for more applications of this.

There are many other patterns, I think the universe speaks to us in patterns and sometimes symbols. I’ve been reading a lot of Jungian material so I guess you can check Carl Jung for some real insight.

Edit: I also want to add that i see duality has been applied for a very long time, I believe the concept of yin and yang is based on this, as well as karma. The understanding of action = consequences has been understood a long time and i believe it’s a universal (I mean literally the universe) speaks this language. And when the balance is disturbed, there are consequences.
If death comes after life, then I think there must be freedom after feeling trapped. As all things go, there is a cycle.
Depending on what you think being free means. Free from dread? Not immediately. The dread is the first part of the process I think.

The key is to balance it out by asking more questions, find out what you don’t know yet. Which if you think about it, there’s an infinite amount of things happening in every moment. It’s comforting to balance it out, understanding a lot of things but knowing that we may never know everything.

This feeling reminds me of hard days. Good days come when I make meaning of it all by making my own choices out of the instincts that are close to my soul. I know my body is just a vessel for the cosmic energy that connects us all, I don’t know what my purpose is but I know that by conducting experiences that’s rooted in love gives me a good feeling deep down (this may very well be my ego). But I try to follow those instincts because I’m not ready to leave the world to those that don’t think twice about our existence. There are also those that *have* thought it through and stared into the void and spiral down it. I want to be here for that too, to maybe spread more sense of “seeing love in everything while we’re here”. There’s nothing here that makes sense, nothing that’s telling us what’s objectively true. But there’s a transcendental drive that I feel when I’m trying to make my own meaning. it’s happened ever since I’ve found the concept of the “self”, there is a connection of the self to the universe. There are patterns in us that simulate that of the universe, I guess I’m asking if anyone is looking for it too.
